title: Unboxing Logitech's $80 Foldable Mouse: Mobi Fold

author: CNET
description:
Move aside Microsoft Surface Arc. 👀🖱️

With its design, Logitech’s Mobi Fold offers 22% less muscle strain compared to a laptop trackpad, and has a battery life for up to 33 days. It retails for $80, comes in four different colors and is available starting June 12.
